The slug of one of this owner's Spaces. The connections to stop sharing it with, by Muse ID. Every selected share granted access and queued its notice, or unsharing completed. Share delivery may still be pending. The connection's Muse ID. When the Space was last shared with them, in epoch milliseconds. Connections the Space is shared with now, oldest grant first. Current human participants, including provider identities awaiting account linking. The connections to share it with, by Muse ID. Optional retry identity. Reuse it when retrying this same share. The Muse ID of the connection who shared it (the host). The Space's slug on the host; open it at
 `/api/peer-spaces/{host_muse}/{slug}/`. The host's name for the Space, at most 120 characters. How many connections the host's share named, including the receiver. When the share arrived, in epoch milliseconds. Spaces connections shared with the owner, newest first. Path parameters shared by every peer-space route. The catch-all's `rest`
 parameter is deliberately absent (serde ignores it): the frame path is
 taken raw from the URI because `Path` percent-decodes. Shared Spaces appear in the artifact catalog and its live removal stream. This runtime projects peer conversations as owner-visible, read-only
